title: E1013 integration path after the data-lake removal
source: RWB-E1-013; Arch v5 slides 15 and 37; DP-17
description: RWB-E1-013 names the INT-19 extract to the data lake and a Power BI refresh, but Arch v5 removes the data lake (DP-17) and has rwb-reporting publish ReportPublished and rwb-integration deliver the regulatory extract; the v5 measure_definition load path and the numbered catalogue entry for ReportPublished are also absent from the Ownership Map.
evidence: RWB-E1-013 AC3/AC7 and section 12 (INT-19); Arch v5 slide 15 (P9 OUT: ReportPublished; TMP deliverFile); slide 37 (no data lake); DP-17; Ownership Map P9
proposed: Test the v5 path: rwb-reporting projects from events and the P1 snapshot activity, publishes on rwb.reporting.events.v1, and rwb-integration delivers the regulatory extract; keep the lake assertion out of the wave 1 suite.

title: E1015 integration slice crosses the wave 2 payment service and the removed lake
source: RWB-E1-015; Arch v5 slides 15, 17, 41 and 44; DP-17
description: AC1 asserts that JOB-07 and JOB-08 start, but those jobs are rwb-payment (P8), a wave 2 service, while EP01 is wave 1. AC9 keeps the released case list in the lake, but Arch v5 removes the data lake (DP-17) and the released case list is P1's case_list_row projection. Evidence: RWB-E1-015 AC1 and AC9; Arch v5 slide 17 (P8 in the service contracts) and slide 44 (JOB-07 and JOB-08 owned by rwb-payment); slide 37 (no data lake); DP-17; Ownership Map P8 wave 2.
evidence: RWB-E1-015 AC1 and AC9; Arch v5 slide 17 (P8 service contract); Arch v5 slide 44 (JOB-07 and JOB-08 owned by rwb-payment); Arch v5 slide 37 (no data lake); DP-17 (data lake removed); Ownership Map P8 wave 2.
proposed: Wave 1 asserts JOB-02 (P3) and JOB-04 (P1); the P8 JOB-07 and JOB-08 start is verified in RWB-ITG-W2; the released case list is read from P1's case_list_row, not a lake copy.

title: E1016 catalog composition across rwb-source-data, rwb-access and rwb-document
source: RWB-E1-016; Arch v5 slides 15, 16 and 41; ownership rulings ASM-A6-tables-5 and ASM-A6-tables-10
description: AC2's catalog entry combines P1 data products, views, fields and PDPA tags with P4 owner roles and access rows, P3 non-DoA reference data and the P5 retention class; the v5 ownership rulings split these tables and no single catalog contract or P5 retention-class exposure path is specified in the Ownership Map.
evidence: RWB-E1-016 AC2 and section 11; Ownership Map P1 (data_product, data_product_access, sys_fields, sys_objects), P4 (roles, masking), P5 (retention_rule), P3 (lov_value); ASM-A6-tables-5; ASM-A6-tables-10.
proposed: The suite reads P1's catalog API, resolves roles and masking through P4 and the retention class through P5; no service copies another service's table.

title: E1017 retention ownership and the P1 interaction path
source: RWB-E1-017; Arch v5 slides 16, 41 and 44; ownership ruling ASM-A6-tables-10
description: The legacy story runs JOB-17 in P1 over the interaction table and retention_rule; the Ownership Map ruling moves retention to P5 rwb-document and drops P1's retention_rule copy, while the interaction ledger stays P1. The cross-service trigger and API for the P1 interaction rows, and the run-status surface of the P5 retention run, are not specified.
evidence: RWB-E1-017 sections 11 and 12; Arch v5 slide 16 (P5 Schedule: retention), slide 41 (P5 owns retention), slide 44 (JOB-17 rwb-document); Ownership Map P1 drops retention_rule (ASM-A6-tables-10).
proposed: P5 owns the rule and the document archive; each owner applies the rule to its own schema; the suite asserts the rule version, legal holds and the decision-log exclusion through the owners' APIs and Temporal visibility.

title: E1018 case-created event and decision record move to the platform
source: RWB-E1-018; Arch v5 slides 14, 15, 20 and 42; DP-03
description: The legacy AC1 publishes the local caseCreated and writes a P3 decision log; the target publishes rwb.case.CaseCreated.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1 and records the decision through P7 (DecisionRecorded on rwb.decision-record.v1, DP-03); the harness fixture for the ALS batch and the exact synthetic case set are not specified.
evidence: RWB-E1-018 AC1 and section 12; Arch v5 slide 14 (P3 OUT: rwb.case.events.v1 CaseCreated), slide 15 (P7 central decision ledger), slide 42 (EV-01, EV-08); DP-03.
proposed: Assert the Kafka CaseCreated event and the P7 DecisionRecorded ledger entry; use the P7 admin rollback for AC15; seed the batch through the W1J01 harness.
